name: Zane "earl" Hoffman
biography: Earf, also known as Zane, is a DevOps Engineer that does vulnerability research in his free time. Zane recently left active duty as a U.S. Marine, where he did vulnerability research and tool development full time. He is also a certified airplane seamstress, qualified to operate industrial sewing machines to maintain aircraft equipment. He likes to hike, climb rocks, and tear apart devices with his hot air gun, soldering machine, and funny looking glasses.
